source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Ιάκωβος του Ζελέζνιυ - Μπορόκ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(; - 1442)». The same 11 April page keeps his disciple as a separate entry, and the two are told apart by their houses and their dates. Oddly, this page says nothing about the house he is named for: it has him tonsured in the Holy Trinity of Saint Sergius of Radonezh and afterwards ascetic in a monastery of Moscow, and Zheleznyi Borok appears only in his name and on the disciple's page. That gap is in the life. The page prints no couplet and no hymn.
